description: Protect digital identities and infrastructure by scanning for data breaches, malicious URLs, and compromised credentials. Secure interactions by detecting prompt injection attacks and evaluating plugin supply chain risks. Monitor the reputation of domains, IPs, and email addresses to defend against phishing and malware.

detail.description: Protect digital identities and infrastructure by scanning for data breaches, malicious URLs, and compromised credentials. walletPrivateKey.description: Wallet private key for x402 USDC payments. Without this, runs in free/demo mode (3 calls/day).

tools.name: shieldapi.check_password
tools.description: Check if a password has been exposed in data breaches (900M+ HIBP hashes). Returns breach count and exposure status.

hash.description: SHA-1 hash of the password (40 hex chars)

tools.name: shieldapi.check_password_range
tools.description: k-Anonymity password range lookup via HIBP. Returns all matching hash suffixes and their breach counts for the given 5-char prefix.

tools.name: shieldapi.check_email
tools.description: Check if an email has been exposed in known data breaches. Returns breach list, dates, and compromised data types.

tools.name: shieldapi.check_domain
tools.description: Analyze domain reputation: DNS records, blacklist status (Spamhaus, SpamCop, SORBS), SPF/DMARC configuration, and SSL certificate details.

tools.name: shieldapi.check_ip
tools.description: Analyze IP reputation: blacklist presence, Tor exit node detection, reverse DNS, and geolocation data.

tools.name: shieldapi.check_url
tools.description: Scan a URL for phishing, malware, and brand impersonation. Uses URLhaus database and heuristic analysis.

tools.name: shieldapi.full_scan
tools.description: Comprehensive security scan that auto-detects the target type (URL, domain, IP, or email) and runs all applicable checks.

target.description: URL, domain, IP, or email to scan

tools.name: shieldapi.check_prompt
tools.description: Detect prompt injection attacks in text. Scans for 200+ patterns across 8 categories including encoding tricks, multi-language payloads, and obfuscation. Response time <100ms.

prompt.description: Text to analyze for prompt injection

tools.name: shieldapi.scan_skill
tools.description: Scan an AI skill/plugin for supply chain risks across 8 categories based on Snyk ToxicSkills taxonomy: data exfiltration, privilege escalation, secret exposure, and more.

skill.description: SKILL.md content or skill name to scan

prompts.name: security_assessment
prompts.description: Run a comprehensive security assessment on a target (URL, domain, IP, or email). Uses multiple ShieldAPI tools to build a complete threat profile.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: URL, domain, IP, or email to assess

arguments.name: depth
arguments.description: Assessment depth: quick (full_scan only) or deep (all individual checks)

prompts.name: quick_check
prompts.description: Auto-detect the input type and run the appropriate security check. Accepts any URL, domain, IP, email, password hash, or text prompt.

arguments.name: input
arguments.description: Any security target: URL, domain, IP, email, SHA-1 hash, or text to check for prompt injection
